more_info.overview: Lycopene is used as a color in food. Its technological role is to add or restore food colour.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include meal replacement for weight control as referred to in Commission Regulation (EU) no 432/2012, flavoured drinks, flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, edible cheese rind. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: For lycopene: No ADI specified (JECFA, 2009). This evaluation does not establish an ADI for every form in the named group.
more_info.origin: Specified lycopene preparations can be made by chemical synthesis, extracted from tomatoes, or produced by fermentation with Blakeslea trispora. The source depends on the preparation.
